title: Fix reopened in firstmate study; queue a fix when source check fails
summary: Correct the firstmate-work-handling study so 'reopened' is non-terminal and returns the item to its queue (model.json, and intro.json, which holds both the lead-in and the glossary entry), citing bin/fm-teardown.sh lines. Make drain queue one fix request via StewardRequest when the source check fails, skipping any contradiction an open request already cites.

defaults_applied.how: drain test plus fmt, clippy and test suite criteria
site build and source check pass is a criterion
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (source check at ~2438-2464 stores check.detail in held_back and queues nothing; check_page is the step) and crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (StewardRequest::new builder, also used by hestia.rs and code_health.rs). No record or data file is added under crates/.

The request lists studies/firstmate-work-handling/glossary.json, but that file does not exist at the base commit; the glossary lives in intro.json, so the glossary fix is made there and no glossary.json is created.
Existing code: extends crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs and reuses crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs StewardRequest; duplicate detection checks open queued requests for the cited statement.
Audience: the drain operator and study readers, who need the contradiction fixed once and not reported every drain.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) are not changed.

acceptance_criteria.text: studies/firstmate-work-handling/model.json no longer marks state 'reopened' terminal-success (t9 ready -> reopened) and shows reopened returning the item to the queue, citing bin/fm-teardown.sh lines; check with git diff.

studies/firstmate-work-handling/intro.json lead-in no longer says Done and Reopened both end the task, and its glossary entry no longer calls reopened 'the final state'; it says reopened returns the item to its queue, with a source citation. Check with git diff and Grep for 'final state'.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: it builds the study without error and the drain source check passes on the corrected study, showing reopened returning the item to the queue.

A new drain.rs test with a fake source check reporting a contradiction shows exactly one fix request queued citing the contradicted statement and its source, built through StewardRequest, and none on a second run while it is open. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry covering the study correction and the drain fix-request queueing.

out_of_scope: Changing the source check model call itself
departures: Two-part change touching a large drain.rs plus study data raises cost slightly over reference.
urgent_reason: Stops the same contradiction being reported on every drain, cutting duplicated checks.
hard_reason: Changes drain, the run pipeline's gate that decides whether a source check failure queues work.
